nodes.label: EC2 g4dn.xlarge GPU Backend
nodes.rationale: Merges the two separate compute deployments (Render CPU + RunPod GPU) into one g4dn.xlarge box running the existing Docker container, cutting moving parts and bills; image built directly on the instance from a git clone to avoid Docker Hub/ECR per the GitHub+AWS-only rule.

nodes.label: DynamoDB Database (5 tables)
nodes.rationale: Firestore subcollections map to composite primary keys (uid partition key + item id sort key); the browser now talks to the backend instead of directly to the DB so all credentials stay server-side; on-demand capacity avoids planning for a small app.

nodes.label: Amazon Cognito Authentication
nodes.rationale: Keeps the existing Authorization: Bearer <token> seam and only changes the token issuer; Hosted UI with Authorization Code + PKCE handles Google and email/password without maintaining a custom form; Cognito assigns a new sub so users must be re-keyed by email.

nodes.label: S3 + CloudFront Frontend Hosting
nodes.rationale: S3 bucket kept private, reached only via CloudFront Origin Access Control; ACM cert must live in us-east-1 for CloudFront; www is canonical because Squarespace cannot CNAME the apex at CloudFront.

nodes.label: Caddy HTTPS Reverse Proxy
nodes.rationale: Auto-obtains/renews Let's Encrypt certs and proxies api.chopchopmol.com to localhost:10000; disables response buffering on SSE streaming endpoints so long ML jobs stream correctly.

nodes.label: chopchopmol-2-0-3 Secondary Service
nodes.rationale: A separate older Render deployment serving /chat, /tosmiles, /analysis whose source is not in any local repo; blocks full Render decommission until folded into the main backend, migrated as a second container, or removed if dead.

nodes.label: Periodic Boundary Conditions (PBC) Visualization
nodes.rationale: Lattice data is parsed but not displayed; needed for crystal structures, materials science, and surface chemistry (unit cell box, cell replication, atom wrapping, minimum image convention).

nodes.label: Advanced Selection Language
nodes.rationale: Current selection is limited to atom indices or element type; proposes resname/within/chain/bonded-to and SMARTS matching for protein analysis, ligand binding sites, and functional groups.

nodes.label: Normal Mode Animation (Vibrations)
nodes.rationale: ORCA parser already extracts vibrational frequencies but lacks visualization; would enable spectroscopy interpretation and phonon visualization via animated normal modes and IR/Raman spectra.

nodes.label: Reaction Path / NEB Support
nodes.rationale: Load Nudged Elastic Band trajectories with energy profiles and transition-state identification for catalysis research and reaction mechanism studies.

nodes.label: Electron Density / Orbital Visualization
nodes.rationale: Load Gaussian cube files, render isosurfaces via marching cubes, show HOMO/LUMO and electrostatic potential for quantum chemistry and reactivity prediction.

nodes.label: WebGPU Rendering
nodes.rationale: Promises 10-100x performance for large molecules but high implementation effort.

nodes.label: TypeScript Migration
nodes.rationale: Type safety and better tooling at high effort; the codebase is currently vanilla JS.

nodes.label: Plugin / Extension System
nodes.rationale: User-defined AI tools, custom file format parsers, and third-party visualization plugins.

nodes.label: Guavion (Company)
nodes.rationale: Guavion is the operating entity (Palo Alto, California; support@guavion.com) offering the Service as a demo / early-access product under sole-discretion access requests.

nodes.label: Bring Your Own API Key (BYOK)
nodes.rationale: User-supplied Anthropic/OpenAI keys are kept only in the browser localStorage and attached per-request over HTTPS so the backend never stores, logs, or persists them — a trust/privacy guarantee that lets users use their own provider accounts without server-side key custody.

nodes.label: Fine-tuning a MACE MLIP using PySCF — Practical Guide
nodes.norm_label: fine-tuning a mace mlip using pyscf — practical guide

nodes.label: Core Fine-tuning Loop
nodes.rationale: Iterative loop (generate structures → PySCF labels → train MACE → test → add hard cases via active learning → retrain) so the fast surrogate reproduces accurate quantum-chemistry labels.

nodes.label: Direct Learning Target
nodes.rationale: Simplest approach: train MACE to predict PySCF energies and forces directly. Preferred when no decent baseline potential exists.

nodes.label: Delta-Learning (ΔE Correction)
nodes.rationale: Train a correction model for ΔE = E(PySCF) − E(base); final prediction = base + correction. More data-efficient, converges faster and is more stable when a decent baseline potential already exists.

nodes.label: Geometry Dataset Construction
nodes.rationale: Most important step: models fail mainly from lack of coverage. Include near-equilibrium, small distortions, finite-temperature MD snapshots, reaction/transition geometries, and edge cases so the model does not extrapolate wildly.

nodes.label: PySCF Labeling (Energies + Gradients)
nodes.rationale: Run one consistent PySCF setup (method, basis, charge, spin, convergence) per geometry; store total energy and nuclear gradients where forces = −gradients.

nodes.label: Unit Conversion (Hartree/Bohr → eV/Å)
nodes.rationale: PySCF outputs Hartree and Hartree/Bohr, but MACE/ASE expects eV and eV/Å. 1 Hartree = 27.211386245988 eV; 1 Bohr = 0.529177210903 Å; forces multiplied by (27.211386245988 / 0.529177210903). Sign convention critical: forces are negative gradients.

nodes.label: MLIP-Friendly Storage Format
nodes.rationale: ASE Atoms objects with per-structure energy, forces, optional stress/virial; formats like extended XYZ, .traj, HDF5. Consistency (atom ordering, units, metadata) matters more than format.

nodes.label: MACE Fine-tuning Strategy
nodes.rationale: Loss combines energy + forces with forces weighted much higher; use a lower learning rate than training from scratch; train output head first then unfreeze deeper layers; monitor validation energy MAE (eV/atom) and force RMSE (eV/Å); keep a held-out validation set with difficult geometries.

nodes.label: Two-Phase Training Recipe
nodes.rationale: Phase A: freeze most layers and train output head for stability (short run). Phase B: unfreeze more layers and continue with smaller learning rate.

nodes.label: Active Learning Loop
nodes.rationale: Run short MD/relaxation with current model, select frames with large forces / instability / model disagreement, recompute with PySCF, append to dataset and retrain. Gives better robustness than adding random data.

nodes.label: PySCF-Specific Pitfalls
nodes.rationale: SCF convergence can fail on distorted geometries (add retries/fallbacks); keep charge and spin consistent; for periodic pyscf.pbc systems watch k-points and basis; filter out non-converged calculations.

nodes.label: Fine-tuning Modes (Scratch / Domain Adaptation / Δ-model)
nodes.rationale: From scratch: train MACE only on PySCF data. Domain adaptation: start from pretrained MACE checkpoint and fine-tune on PySCF set. Δ-model: keep base potential and train only the correction to PySCF.

nodes.rationale: Exposing window.undoManager globally lets the AI undo/redo tools work.

nodes.label: Frame/energy desync fixed (Critical)
nodes.rationale: frameEnergies and lastMaceResults are now cleared everywhere xyzFrames is cleared; loadFrames() auto-syncs energies.

nodes.label: SSE JSON.parse wrapped in try/catch (Critical)
nodes.rationale: Malformed SSE chunks are skipped instead of crashing the stream.

nodes.label: Mutating AI tools serialized (Critical)
nodes.rationale: Read-only tools (L1/L6) run in parallel; mutating tools (L3/L4/L5) run sequentially to prevent race conditions.

nodes.label: Feature gating fixed (Critical)
nodes.rationale: updateFeatureAccess() now respects the signedIn parameter instead of always enabling everything.

nodes.label: ORCA parser frame/energy mismatch (Critical)
nodes.rationale: frameEnergies.push() now only happens when a frame is actually added.

nodes.label: selectAtom bounds check (High)
nodes.rationale: Early return for out-of-range indices.

nodes.label: Missing undo snapshots (High)
nodes.rationale: transform_atoms and split_molecule now call saveUndoState().

nodes.label: analyzeMolecule error handler (High)

nodes.label: generateAngleScan validation (High)
nodes.rationale: Validates atomsToMove before use.

nodes.label: Tool arguments JSON.parse guarded (High)

nodes.label: SSE timeout timer leak (Medium)

nodes.label: streamMaceSSE buffer tail handling (Medium)

nodes.label: Zero force treated as missing (Medium)

nodes.label: postJson body override (Medium)
